name: Sant Llorenç de la Muga (Spain)
description: Divided per bend sinister, yellow above and light blue below.
history: The flag was approved on 9 October 2009 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5491 of 26 October 2009; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, bicolour per bend sinister yellow and light blue, representing the gold of the field and the blue of the wavy fess of the arms while omitting the black gridiron for greater simplicity.
